rephrased_query: create links between notes in Obsidian
expected_answer: Use [[WikiLinks]] to create internal links between notes. Typing [[ opens link suggestions, and [[Note name]] links to a note.

rephrased_query: frontmatter properties in notes
expected_answer: Frontmatter properties are YAML key-value pairs at the top of a note, enclosed by triple dashes, and are used as note metadata.

rephrased_query: use tags to organize notes in Obsidian
expected_answer: Tags let you label notes with #tag names and then search, filter, or query them to organize related notes across folders.

rephrased_query: keyboard shortcuts and hotkeys in Obsidian
expected_answer: Obsidian lets you view and customize keyboard shortcuts in the Hotkeys settings.

rephrased_query: Obsidian Canvas is an infinite whiteboard for arranging notes and ideas.
expected_answer: Canvas lets you create an infinite whiteboard to arrange notes and other items visually.

rephrased_query: reuse the structure of a note with templates
expected_answer: Templates let you reuse a note structure by inserting predefined content into new notes.

rephrased_query: Search the contents of your vault using the Search view.
expected_answer: Use the Search view to search inside your vault. You can search for text, filters, and regular expressions.

rephrased_query: Use callout boxes and admonitions to highlight information in notes
expected_answer: Callouts are a special block syntax used to highlight information in notes; admonitions are another name for the same feature.

rephrased_query: view backlinks for a note in Obsidian
expected_answer: Open the note and use the Backlinks pane to see notes that link to it.

rephrased_query: Use the Daily notes core plugin for journaling and date-based notes
expected_answer: The Daily notes core plugin creates and opens a note for the current day, which is useful for journaling.

rephrased_query: connect notes and view how they relate in Graph view
expected_answer: Use links and Graph view to connect notes and visualize relationships between them.

rephrased_query: insert a predefined text snippet into a note
expected_answer: You can use templates or text expansion methods to insert predefined text into notes.

rephrased_query: visualize the graph of linked notes
expected_answer: Use Graph view to visualize your notes and their connections in the vault.

rephrased_query: Use tags or properties to add keywords and topics for filtering notes
expected_answer: You can add tags, aliases, or properties to notes and then filter or search by them in Obsidian.

rephrased_query: switch between Live Preview and Source mode
expected_answer: You can switch between reading and editing by using Live Preview and Source mode in the note options or command palette.

rephrased_query: How does the graph of note connections work in Obsidian?
expected_answer: The Graph view visualizes links between notes and lets you explore connections; each node is a note and each line is a link.

rephrased_query: use tags to organize notes in a vault
expected_answer: Tags can be used to group and find notes in a vault, and tag panes or search can help organize content.

rephrased_query: write mathematical formulas in notes using LaTeX math blocks
expected_answer: Obsidian supports inline math and display math using LaTeX syntax in notes.

rephrased_query: callout syntax for warning info tip blocks
expected_answer: Callouts use the syntax > [!type] with optional title text, and support types like note, tip, info, warning, and question.

rephrased_query: embed a block or section from another note with a block reference
expected_answer: Use a block reference to embed a specific block or heading section from another note.

rephrased_query: Use Bases to view notes in a table and work with database-like properties
expected_answer: Bases lets you create table, board, list, and chart views over your notes, using properties as database fields.

rephrased_query: use an alias as an alternative name for a note
expected_answer: An alias is an alternative name for a note, shown in search results and backlinks, while the note's filename stays the same.

rephrased_query: Embed a file or note using a wikilink
expected_answer: You can embed a note with ![[Note]] and a file with ![[file.png]], using the same wikilink syntax with a leading exclamation mark.

rephrased_query: How to install community plugins in Obsidian
expected_answer: To install community plugins, turn off Restricted mode in Community plugins, then browse and install a plugin from the community plugin browser.

rephrased_query: Change the app theme and appearance color scheme
expected_answer: You can change the theme in Settings > Appearance, and adjust the color scheme there as well.

rephrased_query: Use CSS snippets to customize Obsidian appearance
expected_answer: CSS snippets can be used to customize Obsidian styles. Store them in the snippets folder and enable them in Appearance.

rephrased_query: sync a vault across devices using Obsidian Sync or another remote location
expected_answer: Obsidian Sync synchronizes a vault across devices. A remote vault is a vault stored in a remote location that can be opened on multiple devices.

rephrased_query: publish notes as a website or digital garden
expected_answer: Obsidian Publish lets you publish notes to the web as a website or digital garden.

rephrased_query: save a webpage to a vault with the browser extension Web Clipper
expected_answer: Web Clipper can save webpages directly to your vault from the browser extension.

rephrased_query: Import notes from Evernote or Notion into Obsidian
expected_answer: Obsidian can import notes from Evernote and Notion, usually by exporting from the source app first and then importing the exported files.

rephrased_query: restore a previous version from File recovery snapshots
expected_answer: To restore a previous version, open File recovery and select the snapshot you want to restore.

rephrased_query: save and load a workspace layout in Obsidian
expected_answer: You can save the current workspace as a layout and load it later from the Workspaces core plugin.

rephrased_query: run commands from the Command palette with Ctrl+P
expected_answer: Press Ctrl+P to open the Command palette, then type the command name and press Enter to run it.

rephrased_query: Use Bookmarks to quickly access notes, folders, and saved searches.
expected_answer: Bookmarks can save notes, folders, and searches for quick access from the sidebar.

rephrased_query: Use the Outline pane to navigate headings in a note
expected_answer: The Outline pane shows headings in the current note and lets you jump to them.

rephrased_query: show a page preview when hovering over an internal link
expected_answer: Page preview appears when you hover over an internal link if the feature is enabled in Editor or Page preview settings.

rephrased_query: record audio and insert it in a note using the microphone
expected_answer: You can record audio from the microphone and insert the recording into a note.

rephrased_query: merge notes and extract a selection into a new note in Obsidian
expected_answer: You can merge notes or extract selected text into a new note from the note options or context menu.

rephrased_query: manage and switch between multiple vaults using the vault switcher
expected_answer: You can create, open, and switch between multiple vaults from the vault switcher.

rephrased_query: Set the default folder for attachments in Obsidian
expected_answer: You can set the default location for new attachments in Settings under Files & Links, including the vault folder, same folder as the current note, or a custom folder.

rephrased_query: collapse headings to hide the content beneath them
expected_answer: You can fold headings to hide the content beneath them and collapse sections in the editor.

rephrased_query: create unique note identifiers using timestamps in Zettelkasten
expected_answer: Zettelkasten note IDs can be created from a timestamp so each note gets a unique identifier.

rephrased_query: create a slideshow presentation from markdown notes
expected_answer: You can turn a note into a slideshow using Slides Creator or by exporting the note to PDF/HTML depending on your workflow.

rephrased_query: Show word and character counts in the status bar
expected_answer: The status bar can show the current note's word count and character count when enabled in editor settings.

rephrased_query: open external links in the web viewer inside Obsidian
expected_answer: Links clicked in the web viewer can be opened in Obsidian if the external link handler or external browser setting is used.

rephrased_query: restore a deleted note from File recovery
expected_answer: To recover a deleted note, use File recovery to browse snapshots and restore the note.

rephrased_query: link to a note using a different display name
expected_answer: Use a wiki link alias to display a note under a different name, for example [[Note title|Display name]].

rephrased_query: install community plugins to extend Obsidian's functionality
expected_answer: You can extend Obsidian by installing community plugins, which are third-party extensions.

rephrased_query: save and restore workspace layouts for different tasks in Obsidian
expected_answer: Workspaces lets you save the current window layout and switch between different arrangements for different tasks.

rephrased_query: save a web article to a note with Web Clipper
expected_answer: Use Web Clipper to save web pages or articles into Obsidian notes.

rephrased_query: import notes from another app into Obsidian
expected_answer: You can bring notes into Obsidian by adding their files to your vault, often by copying or moving them into the vault folder and then opening or importing them there.

rephrased_query: sync notes across devices in Obsidian
expected_answer: Obsidian Sync can keep your notes updated across devices, and you can also use another sync method if you prefer.

rephrased_query: embed an image in a note
expected_answer: To embed an image in a note, paste it, drag it into the note, or use Markdown image syntax with a file path.

rephrased_query: publish notes to the web
expected_answer: Publish notes to the web allows you to share notes publicly through an Obsidian Publish site.

rephrased_query: Use ![[...]] to embed a note, attachment, or image in Obsidian.
expected_answer: The ![[...]] syntax embeds notes and attachments. You can embed an image by using its filename inside double brackets.

rephrased_query: Open a note in Obsidian using an obsidian:// URI from another app
expected_answer: Obsidian supports obsidian:// URIs that can open a note, search, create a file, or open a workspace from an external app.

rephrased_query: Trigger a slash command in the editor
expected_answer: Typing / in the editor opens the command menu, letting you run commands from the keyboard.

rephrased_query: Bases filter formula syntax in YAML configuration
expected_answer: Bases can be configured in YAML, and filters use formula syntax to define which files are included.

rephrased_query: Zettelkasten Prefixer plugin
expected_answer: Zettelkasten Prefixer adds date or custom prefixes to note titles to support Zettelkasten workflows.

rephrased_query: cancel an Obsidian subscription
expected_answer: To cancel a subscription, go to the billing page and manage the subscription from there.

rephrased_query: what are Insider builds in Obsidian
expected_answer: Insider builds are beta versions of Obsidian that give early access to new features and fixes before the stable release.

rephrased_query: How to use Migration Assistant in Obsidian
expected_answer: Migration Assistant helps move data into Obsidian from another app or service.

rephrased_query: switch between vaults
expected_answer: Use the vault switcher to open or create another vault, or to switch to a recent vault.

rephrased_query: Settings profiles let you manage different app settings for different devices or use cases.
expected_answer: Settings profiles let you switch between different sets of app settings.

rephrased_query: backlinks panel not showing
expected_answer: If the Backlinks pane is missing, re-enable the Backlinks core plugin or open Backlinks from the note menu.

rephrased_query: make callouts collapsible in Obsidian
expected_answer: Callouts can be collapsed by adding a collapse indicator in the callout syntax.

rephrased_query: publish Obsidian Publish on a custom domain with Cloudflare
expected_answer: Obsidian Publish can use a custom domain by adding the required DNS records in Cloudflare and then verifying the domain in Obsidian.

rephrased_query: sync a vault with iCloud on iPhone
expected_answer: Obsidian Sync is not required to use iCloud; on iPhone, place the vault in iCloud Drive and open it from Obsidian.

rephrased_query: Why do my phone and laptop show different notes in Obsidian Sync?
expected_answer: If two devices show different notes, check that both are syncing the same vault and that sync has completed on each device.

rephrased_query: See what is slowing Obsidian down during startup using the performance profiler
expected_answer: Use the performance profiler to inspect startup time and identify slow plugins or operations.

rephrased_query: restore notes after reinstalling Obsidian on Android
expected_answer: If your notes were stored locally and you did not use sync or backups, reinstalling the app can remove the local vault data on Android.

rephrased_query: gift an Obsidian Sync subscription to another person
expected_answer: You can buy a Sync subscription for someone else by entering their email during checkout. They receive an invitation to activate it.

rephrased_query: change the app font size and interface zoom
expected_answer: You can make the text and UI bigger using the app’s Appearance settings, including font size and zoom.

rephrased_query: show the same text block in multiple notes without duplicating it
expected_answer: Use transclusion by embedding a note or block so the same content appears in multiple notes.

rephrased_query: Starred notes and starred files in Obsidian
expected_answer: Starred items are added to the Starred core plugin for quick access.

rephrased_query: iframe in Obsidian notes
expected_answer: Use HTML iframe tags in notes to embed external web content, subject to security and source restrictions.

rephrased_query: Vim key bindings in Obsidian
expected_answer: Obsidian supports a Vim mode that changes editor shortcuts and navigation to Vim key bindings.

rephrased_query: move notes to trash and restore deleted notes
expected_answer: Trash is where deleted notes are kept before permanent removal, and you can restore or permanently delete them.

rephrased_query: regular expressions in Obsidian
expected_answer: Regex can be used in search and replace, and Obsidian uses JavaScript-style regular expressions.

rephrased_query: Use footnotes in a note
expected_answer: Footnotes let you add references in the form [^1] and define them at the bottom of the note.

rephrased_query: Is there a student discount or other reduced pricing for Obsidian Sync?
expected_answer: Obsidian Sync is sold only through the regular plans; there is no student pricing or discount mentioned.

rephrased_query: Hotkeys on a German keyboard use the physical key positions, not the typed letters
expected_answer: Keyboard shortcuts are based on physical key positions, so on non-QWERTY layouts the printed letters may be in different places.

rephrased_query: list of servers the desktop app connects to
expected_answer: Obsidian does not publish a fixed list of servers for the desktop app because features connect to different services depending on what you use.

rephrased_query: collaborating in the same note at the same time in a shared vault
expected_answer: When multiple people edit the same note at once, Obsidian handles conflicts by preserving changes and may create conflict copies rather than silently losing edits.

rephrased_query: back up a vault to a Git repository using the Git plugin
expected_answer: Obsidian can back up a vault to a Git repository by using the Git plugin to initialize a repository, commit changes, and push them to a remote.

rephrased_query: restore a note from version history without Obsidian Sync
expected_answer: Version history for notes is available only with Obsidian Sync.

rephrased_query: show the notes that the current note links to
expected_answer: The Links panel shows outgoing links from the current note.

rephrased_query: Add all notes in a folder to a Canvas
expected_answer: You can add all notes from a folder to a canvas by using the folder as a source for cards or by dragging the folder contents onto the canvas.

rephrased_query: insert the current date at the cursor
expected_answer: You can insert today's date at the cursor with the Insert current date command or the {{date}} template if supported.

rephrased_query: Exclude a folder from sync
expected_answer: You can exclude a folder from sync in Settings by adding it to the list of excluded folders.

rephrased_query: password-protect a published site so only invited people can access it
expected_answer: Publish sites can be protected with a password so only people who know it can open the site.

rephrased_query: select a rectangular selection with the mouse in Obsidian
expected_answer: You can make a rectangular selection by holding Alt/Option while dragging with the mouse.

rephrased_query: Connect Ollama to the Web Clipper
expected_answer: The Web Clipper can use Ollama by setting it up as a local model provider and then selecting it in the clipper settings.

rephrased_query: .git folder excluded from Obsidian Sync
expected_answer: Obsidian Sync does not upload the .git folder because it treats it as excluded or ignored hidden content.

rephrased_query: Downgrade an Obsidian Sync plan while keeping version history
expected_answer: Version history is tied to your Sync plan. Downgrading may reduce how much version history is kept, depending on the new plan.

rephrased_query: How to include a code block inside another code block in Obsidian
expected_answer: Use indentation or alternative fencing to display nested code blocks, since Markdown code fences cannot be directly nested.

rephrased_query: preserve outline structure when importing from Logseq
expected_answer: Logseq imports preserve the outline structure by keeping blocks and nesting.

rephrased_query: How to write a markdown link when the URL contains spaces
expected_answer: URLs in Markdown links should be encoded; spaces must be replaced with %20 or the link may not work.

rephrased_query: disable automatic updates in Obsidian
expected_answer: You can disable automatic updates in Settings. On desktop, turn off the option to automatically check for updates.

rephrased_query: protect an Obsidian Publish site with a password
expected_answer: Obsidian Publish does not support password protection for published sites.

rephrased_query: How long version history is kept in Obsidian Sync
expected_answer: Version history in Obsidian Sync is kept for 1 year.

rephrased_query: student and non-profit discounts in Obsidian
expected_answer: Obsidian offers a 40% discount for students and non-profit organizations on Sync and Publish subscriptions.

rephrased_query: move a remote vault to another sync server
expected_answer: To move a remote vault to another sync server, set up sync on the new device, then reconnect the vault and let the new server become the sync target.

rephrased_query: comment markers and comments in Obsidian
expected_answer: Comments are hidden text markers in notes and templates.

rephrased_query: What does ==highlight== mean in Obsidian?
expected_answer: Use ==text== to highlight text in a note.

rephrased_query: link to a block in a note using #^block
expected_answer: Block references use the syntax [[note#^block]] to link to a specific block in a note.

rephrased_query: math notation in Obsidian with $$
expected_answer: Display math in Obsidian can be written using double dollar signs $$ to create a block equation.

rephrased_query: Create a folded callout with the FAQ type
expected_answer: Use a callout like > [!faq]- to make the callout folded by default.

rephrased_query: What is {{title}} in Obsidian?
expected_answer: {{title}} is a template token used to insert the note title.

rephrased_query: filter files modified in the last week
expected_answer: Use file.mtime in a Dataview query to compare a file’s modification time against now() minus a duration like "1 week".

rephrased_query: work in Obsidian without an internet connection
expected_answer: Obsidian can be used offline; you can keep editing your notes without internet, and changes sync later when connection returns.

rephrased_query: Does Obsidian Publish use cookies to track visitors?
expected_answer: Obsidian Publish does not use cookies to track visitors.

rephrased_query: Obsidian compatibility with Apple Lockdown Mode
expected_answer: Obsidian can be used in Apple Lockdown Mode, but some features that rely on web content or external services may be restricted by the mode.

rephrased_query: maximum number of people in a shared vault
expected_answer: A shared vault can have up to 10 members.

rephrased_query: Graph view is not available on Obsidian Publish sites.
expected_answer: Obsidian Publish does not support Graph view on published sites.
